activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1876 as Wagner's representative German artistic milestone year, when the first Bayreuth Festival opened and presented the first complete festival realization of his Ring project.

sources.title: Festival History — Bayreuth Festival
sources.citation_text: The official Bayreuth Festival history records the opening of the first festival on 13 August 1876 and the three Ring cycles presented at the inaugural festival.
